items.title: At least four Palestinians killed in Gaza as Israeli attacks continue
items.description: Israel carried out several attacks in Gaza, including shelling the Nuseirat refugee camp.

items.title: After the Trappes terrorist attack, a community hopes that France will wake up to the far-right threat
items.description: Emotion ran high during the memorial ceremony held on Friday in Trappes, one week after a racist terrorist attack left one person dead and seven others wounded. The town's left-wing mayor was joined by left-wing political leaders, while leaders from the rest of the political spectrum did not come.

items.title: Residents from Russian-occupied Oleshky reunite with families after evacuation operation
items.description: Evacuees from Oleshky crossed into Ukrainian-held territory Saturday in a major rescue operation after travelling through Belarus during a rare truce brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump. The city of Oleshky has been under Russian occupation since 2022 and was caught in intense fighting that left residents starving …

items.title: Aid Deliveries and Evacuations in Oleshky Begin After Demining Operation Wraps Up

items.title: World News in Brief: 5 children killed in Sudan, Haiti hunger emergency, Yemen war update
items.description: At least five children were killed and two others injured in a drone attack on a market in Nyala, in Sudan’s South Darfur state, on Monday, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Thursday.

items.title: Russian Drone Attack Kills 14 In Dnipro As Oleshky Truce Enters Third Day
items.description: A Russian attack on Ukraine's eastern city of Dnipro killed at least 14 people and injured more than 10 others, according to Ukrainian officials, as a fragile cease-fire around Russian-occupied Oleshky entered its third day on October 29.
